subject: ClearGRC evidence conduit — sprint plan & security gating
messages:
From: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@cleargrc.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: integrations@cleargrc.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearGRC — evidence transfer & onboarding kickoff

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the kickoff call this morning. We ran through the high-level flow but wanted to capture the concrete items ClearGRC needs to onboard the Redwood evidence conduit:

1) A target S3 ARN + IAM role that ClearGRC can write to (we prefer a role assumption pattern).
2) List of evidence types and retention TTL (so we can map metadata fields).
3) A short HMAC key rotation window/expectations for signed requests.
4) Access for our integration engineer (nat.cho@cleargrc.com) to a test bucket and a staging user for smoke tests.

Attached is a CSV with the sample ARN formats we accept. Can you confirm what pattern Redwood wants for bucket naming and whether you require SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key?

We also attached a short draft SOW (PDF) that lists a 2-week integration sprint; we'll adjust based on Redwood's security gating.

Best,
Natalie
--
Natalie Cho
Head of Integrations, ClearGRC
attachments: cleargrc-s3-arn.csv, cleargrc-sow-v1.pdf

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@cleargrc.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearGRC — evidence transfer & onboarding kickoff

Thanks Natalie — this is clear and helpful. Looping in Sergio (partner ops) and Aditya (security) to align on the gating checklist.

Proposed plan (high-level, 2-week sprint):
- Day 0–1: Exchange test ARNs and confirm IAM role assumption pattern. Sergio to provision staging bucket and share ARN.
- Day 2–4: ClearGRC spike: write smoke objects & verify metadata mapping against sample schema.
- Day 5–7: Security review: Aditya to validate SSE-KMS, KMS key policy, and HMAC usage.
- Week 2: End-to-end run, audit logs validation, and canary cutover with rollback playbook.

Security gating items we need from ClearGRC (short list):
- Confirmation you will sign requests and include a timestamp (anti-replay).
- Description of retention policy for objects you write.
- Contact for SOC2 evidence transfer questions during the run.

I've attached a one-page sprint workbook to capture deliverables and owners. Sergio — can you create the staging bucket and add the ARN to the workbook by EOD Monday? Aditya — can you confirm whether Redwood requires customer-managed KMS or if we can accept AWS-managed keys for the staging phase?

Natalie — once we have the answers above we'll send a narrow access policy for your engineer to assume.

Thanks,
Soojin
--
Soojin Lee
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
attachments: rwinf-evidence-conduit-sprint.xlsx

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearGRC — evidence transfer & onboarding kickoff

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 11:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed plan (high-level, 2-week sprint):
> - Day 0–1: Exchange test ARNs and confirm IAM role assumption pattern. Sergio to provision staging bucket and share ARN.

Provisioning update: staging bucket created in us-west-2: arn:aws:s3:::rwinf-cleargrc-staging-20270419. I added a narrow assume-role policy for integrations@cleargrc.com with PutObject/ListBucket.

Aditya — I set the KMS key to AWS-managed for now so we can smoke test. If you want customer-managed for the production cutover, I can add a customer-managed CMK and share the key policy.

Next steps (this week):
- Share ARN + temporary assume-role info with Natalie.
- Natalie to run smoke writes and attach the sample metadata file.
- Aditya to run the KMS policy review and suggest changes.

I'll send the assume-role ARN and short guide in the reply to Natalie.

Thanks,
Sergio
--
Sergio Alvarez
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@cleargrc.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: integrations@cleargrc.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearGRC — evidence transfer & onboarding kickoff

Thanks, team — got the staging ARN and the workbook. Quick answers:

- We'll sign requests and include a monotonic timestamp + nonce.
- Retention: default 180 days for proof objects; can be set per-customer if needed.
- Point contact: nat.cho@cleargrc.com and eng-integration@cleargrc.com for the spike.

We've uploaded a small sample payload and metadata to the staging bucket and left a note in the workbook. For transparency I attached the draft SOW with a few edits (see PDF). We're good to run the smoke tests tomorrow morning on your timezone window.

If Aditya wants the CMK for review I can push the production key policy after the smoke test.

Best,
Natalie
attachments: cleargrc-sow-v1.pdf
